vocab.gloss: (after a suppositional clause) in that case; then; (after a clause of action) as soon as; immediately after; (same as 是) merely; nothing else but; simply; just; precisely; exactly

example.pinyin: Wǒ chī bǎo le jiù huí jiā.
example.gloss: I'll go home as soon as I'm full.

vocab.gloss: to want; to need; to ask for; will; shall; about to; need to; should

example.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá.
example.gloss: I want a bubble milk tea.

vocab.gloss: (adverb) also; both ... and ... (before predicates only); (literary) particle having functions similar to 啊

example.pinyin: Wǒ yě xiǎng qù kàn diànyǐng.
example.gloss: I also want to go see a movie.

vocab.gloss: to reach; to arrive; to leave for; to go to; to (a place); until (a time); up to (a point)

example.pinyin: Wǒ bā diǎn dào jiéyùn zhàn.
example.gloss: I'll arrive at the MRT station at eight.

vocab.gloss: still; still in progress; still more
to touch; to come in contact with; to feel

example.gloss: He is sitting and watching TV.

grammar.title: 一……就……(as soon as)
grammar.pattern: Subject + 一 + Verb 1 + 就 + Verb 2
grammar.explanation: 用「一……就……」表示第一個動作發生後，第二個動作馬上發生。「就」放在第二個動詞前面，是台灣人日常很常用的說法。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yí dào jiā jiù dǎ diànhuà.
examples.gloss: As soon as I get home, I'll make a phone call.

examples.pinyin: Tā yí xiàbān jiù qù mǎi biàndāng.
examples.gloss: As soon as he gets off work, he goes to buy a lunchbox.

examples.hanzi: 我一看到她就想起來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yí kàn dào tā jiù xiǎng qǐlái le.
examples.gloss: The moment I saw her, I remembered.

dialogue.speaker: 小天
dialogue.hanzi: 我還在捷運站，十分鐘就到。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ hái zài jiéyùn zhàn, shí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
dialogue.gloss: I'm still at the MRT station; I'll be there in ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 好，我先點一杯珍珠奶茶。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ xiān diǎn yì bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá.
dialogue.gloss: OK, I'll order a bubble milk tea first.

dialogue.speaker: 小天
dialogue.hanzi: 我也要一杯，不要太甜喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě yào yì bēi, búyào tài tián ō.
dialogue.gloss: I want one too, not too sweet, OK?

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.pinyin: Méicuò, wǒ zuò zhe kàn shǒujī.
dialogue.gloss: Got it, I'll sit and look at my phone.

dialogue.speaker: 小天
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie, wǒ yào xià chē le.
dialogue.gloss: Thanks, I'm about to get off the train.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù yóujú jì dōngxi.
sentences.gloss: I want to go to the post office to mail something.

sentences.pinyin: Tā hái zài fángjiān lǐ shuìjiào.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yí dào jiā jiù dǎ diànhuà.
sentences.gloss: As soon as I get home, I'll call.
She is sitting and drinking coffee.

vocab.gloss: to; for; for the benefit of

example.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ yì bēi rè chá.
example.gloss: I'll give you a cup of hot tea.

vocab.gloss: to yield; to permit; to let sb do sth

example.pinyin: Ràng wǒ kàn yíxià nǐ de shǒujī.
example.gloss: Let me take a look at your phone.

vocab.gloss: bar (loanword) (serving drinks, or providing Internet access etc); to puff (on a pipe etc); (onom.) bang
to obtain; to get; to gain

example.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān wǎnshàng shuì de hǎo ma?
example.gloss: Did you sleep well last night?

example.hanzi: 這裡可以用悠遊卡付錢。
example.pinyin: Zhèlǐ kěyǐ yòng Yōuyóukǎ fù qián.
example.gloss: You can pay with an EasyCard here.

vocab.gloss: as (in the capacity of); to take sth as; to act as

example.pinyin: Māma wèi wǒ zuò le wǎnfàn.

grammar.title: 動詞 + 得 + 很 + 形容詞
grammar.explanation: To say how well an action is done, put 得 (de) after the verb and add a description. 他說得很好 means "he speaks well." Note that here 得 is read "de" with a neutral tone. For a negative, say 動詞 + 得 + 不 + 形容詞, for example 我寫得不好.

examples.pinyin: Tā Zhōngwén shuō de hěn hǎo.
Nǐ jīntiān lái de hěn zǎo.
Wǒ de zì xiě de bú piàoliang.

grammar.title: 讓 / 為 + 人 + 動作
grammar.explanation: 讓 means "to let someone do something": 讓我看一下 (let me have a look). 為 means "for the benefit of someone": 為你做飯 (cook for you). Both come before the person.

examples.pinyin: Ràng wǒ wèi nǐ jiārè yíxià.
examples.gloss: Let me heat it up for you.

examples.hanzi: 爸爸讓我騎他的腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Bàba ràng wǒ qí tā de jiǎotàchē.
examples.gloss: Dad let me ride his bike.

dialogue.speaker: 客人
dialogue.hanzi: 老闆，我可以用悠遊卡付錢嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Lǎobǎn, wǒ kěyǐ yòng Yōuyóukǎ fù qián ma?
dialogue.gloss: Boss, can I pay with an EasyCard?

dialogue.gloss: Yes, please swipe your card here.

dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, gěi nǐ. Zhè ge biàndāng kěyǐ jiārè ma?
dialogue.gloss: OK, here you go. Can this lunch box be heated up?

dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ, ràng wǒ wèi nǐ jiārè yíxià ba.
dialogue.gloss: Sure, let me heat it up for you.

dialogue.speaker: 客人
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie, nǐ zuò de hěn kuài.

example.pinyin: Wǒ cóng jiālǐ zǒu dào jiéyùn zhàn.
example.gloss: I walk from home to the MRT station.

example.gloss: The desserts at this shop are the best.

grammar.title: 從……到…… (from ... to ...)
grammar.pattern: 從 + A（時間/位置） + 到 + B（時間/位置）
grammar.explanation: 用「從」說起點，用「到」說終點。可以用在時間上（從幾點到幾點），也可以用在路線上（從哪裡到哪裡）。「從……到……」後面常接動作或說明要多久。

examples.hanzi: 我從早上九點到晚上六點都在上班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn dào wǎnshang liù diǎn dōu zài shàngbān.
examples.gloss: I'm at work from nine in the morning to six at night.

examples.hanzi: 從我家到學校，騎腳踏車十分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào xuéxiào, qí jiǎotàchē shí fēnzhōng.
examples.gloss: From my home to school is ten minutes by bike.

examples.hanzi: 從這裡到那家店要兩個鐘頭。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ dào nà jiā diàn yào liǎng ge zhōngtóu.
examples.gloss: It takes two hours from here to that shop.

grammar.title: 已經……了 (already)
grammar.pattern: 主語 + 已經 + 動詞/形容詞 + 了
grammar.explanation: 「已經」表示動作完成或情況出現了，句尾常常加「了」。

examples.hanzi: 現在已經十點了，我要睡了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng shí diǎn le, wǒ yào shuì le.
examples.gloss: It's already ten o'clock; I'm going to sleep.
